featured_alarm_dossiers.title: ALM-1003 Module Fault

parameters.name: ME ID
parameters.meaning: Identifies the managed element (ME) where the faulty module resides. For details, see the description of each ME

parameters.name: Faulty module number
parameters.meaning: Identifies the faulty module.

parameters.name: Faulty module type
parameters.meaning: Indicates the type of the faulty module, such as SCU, CDB, BSU, or DPU.

parameters.name: Position
parameters.meaning: Indicates the position of the pod running the faulty module. The value contains the pod name and node name.

possible_causes: Operations, such as resetting and switchover, have been performed on the OM Portal , causing the module to become faulty temporarily.
The module stops unexpectedly.
The pod running the faulty module is faulty.
The data on the arbitration PMU is inconsistent with the data in the OMU data file.
The pod CPU is level-4 overloaded. By default, the CPU is level-4 overloaded when the CPU usage reaches 95%.
The file loading onto the pod fails.

featured_alarm_dossiers.alarm_name: Number of Confirmed Patches on the Modules of the Same Type Inconsistent
featured_alarm_dossiers.title: ALM-2375 Number of Confirmed Patches on the Modules of the Same Type Inconsistent

parameters.name: ME ID
parameters.meaning: Identifies the ME for which this alarm is generated. For details, see the description of each ME.

parameters.name: Module type
parameters.meaning: Indicates the type of the module for which the alarm is generated.

possible_causes: The maintenance personnel runs the commands LOD PATCH , ACT PATCH , and CON PATCH to load, activate, or confirm patches on the modules of the same type. However, the operations (loading, activating, and confirming) performed on the modules are different; therefore, the number of confirmed patches on the modules of the same type is inconsistent.
The number of patches on the modules of the same type is different.
Certain modules run improperly. As a result, patches cannot be installed on such modules.

featured_alarm_dossiers.alarm_name: Management Plane Packet Error and Loss
featured_alarm_dossiers.title: ALM-1010 Management Plane Packet Error and Loss

figures.caption: Figure 1 Detecting the packet error and loss ratio if the PMU process has been running for 5 or less minutes
Figure 2 Detecting the packet error and loss ratio if the PMU process has been running for more than 30 minutes

parameters.name: Destination port name
parameters.meaning: Identifies the destination pod port of the management planes whose packet error and loss ratio reached the alarm threshold.

parameters.name: Source port name
parameters.meaning: Identifies the source pod port of the management planes whose packet error and loss ratio reached the alarm threshold.

parameters.name: Packet error and loss ratio (0.1%)
parameters.meaning: Indicates the packet error and loss ratio.

parameters.name: Destination position
parameters.meaning: Describes the position of the pod where the destination port resides.

parameters.name: Source position
parameters.meaning: Describes the position of the pod where the source port resides.

possible_causes: The management planes of the server running the destination pod are abnormal.
The Base port of the destination pod is faulty.
The management planes of the server running the source pod are abnormal.
The Base port of the source pod is faulty.
The CPU of the source pod or destination pod is overloaded.
A virtual port is faulty.

xlsx_cross_link.alarm_name: Management Plane Packet Error and Loss
xlsx_cross_link.location_info: Destination port name=%lu,Source port name=%lu,Packet error and loss ratio(0.1%)=%lu,Destination position=%s,Source position=%s
xlsx_cross_link.alarm_explain: The DOCM module of the IMU or PMU periodically detects the plane. When the packet error and loss ratio of any BASE plane exceeds the threshold, the system generates this alarm.

featured_alarm_dossiers.title: ALM-2376 Automatic Installation Failure of Patch

parameters.name: ME ID
parameters.meaning: Identifies the ME for which the patch fails to be installed automatically.

parameters.name: Patch package name
parameters.meaning: Indicates the name of the patch package that must be installed automatically.

parameters.name: Patch package state
parameters.meaning: Indicates whether a patch package is installed successfully. "Success" indicates a successful installation and "Fail" indicates a failed installation.

parameters.name: Cold patch name
parameters.meaning: Indicates the name of the cold patch that must be installed automatically. If no cold patch is available, this field is empty.

parameters.name: Cold patch state
parameters.meaning: Indicates whether a cold patch package is installed successfully. "Success" indicates a successful installation, "Fail" indicates a failed installation, and "None" indicates that no cold patch is available.

parameters.name: Hot patch name
parameters.meaning: Indicates the name of the hot patch that must be installed automatically. If no hot patch is available, this field is empty.

parameters.name: Hot patch state
parameters.meaning: Indicates whether a hot patch package is installed successfully. "Success" indicates a successful installation, "Fail" indicates a failed installation, and "None" indicates that no hot patch is available.

possible_causes: The patch package fails to be installed due to system reasons.
The hot patch fails to be installed due to system reasons.
The cold patch fails to be installed due to system reasons.
